summary.text: Mary Russell is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 80 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Republican David Meade.
Russell is a registered nurse who earned an associate degree from Eastern Kentucky University in 1999.

paragraphs.text: Mary Russell earned an associate degree from Eastern Kentucky University in 1999, and her career experience includes working as a registered nurse.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a widow, mother, grandmother and retired nurse who was born and raised in Kentucky.
Russell advanced from the Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot after the May 19, 2026, primary was canceled.
In the survey, she listed fully funding public schools and school transportation, livable wages and funding Medicaid as her key campaign messages.
